title: 63:19 We are thine. Israel remembers that Jehovah is her God, her king, her Savior, and she desires a renewal of the covenant made in former times (Deut. 7:6). This statement also reminds us of Paul's expression that we belong to God, having been bought with a price (1 Cor. 6:19-20).
author: Tina M. Peterson
